title: 第687章 你跑不过我你信吗第686章 傲慢与偏见
slug: 骑士先生魔王真的不存在啊
lines: 鉴于唐在两个群体之间的威望，两边人都将目光放到了唐的身上，认真倾听着唐接下来的话。
“无论是精灵，还是人类，你们双方都承认着彼此的作用。”唐关注着两边群体的表情。
现场没有反对声，就和唐说的一样。
“但在同时，你们也抱怨彼此的拖后腿行为，我知晓各位并未将自身的不利迁怒他人……”
唐的演讲不长不短，时间正好能让两方争执的群体静心思考，期间也有两边的人轮番发言。
风过林梢，带来一阵阵树沙声。
“既然你们都觉得自己的表现更优秀，要挫对方的锐气，那就决定一个大家都可以认同的方式，像骑士一样堂堂正正的决出胜负吧。”
精灵与教会两方正有此意，马上就有一位骑士站了出来。
“既然如此，我们就看看战场上谁的作用更大！若是输了，就为你们的傲慢向我们道歉。”
精灵一方不甘示弱，昂首迈出两步：“如果你们输了，就承认自己是无理蛮夷主动惹事，向我们道歉。”
两边战意高涨，谁都不服谁。
“哎呀~如果在团队中闹不合可就麻烦了。”睡醒的白毛团子正好飞过。
姆莉接住自己老爹，看向前方一群人：“不如每一处战场上都留两个观察员，对照确定各方作用的同时警戒暗处偷袭怎么样？”
双方点头同意，击拳起誓。
好歹是良性竞争，小矛盾平复，大家依旧能够和平相处，不过彼此之间的胜负欲却是变得前所未有的高。
“好多烤肉喵~还有人要烤肉喵？”妮蔻抱着一大桶烤肉出现，好像大肚产妇一样，走路也是一步一探。
“我们这里！”
“我们也要！”
“我们人类更能吃肉！精灵还是多吃点素吧！”
“你们懂什么叫荤素结合吗？知道每日所需蛋白是多少吗？知道什么是膳食纤维吗？蛮夷。”
妮蔻看着眼前一大群伸手要饭的家伙，放下烤肉桶，嫌弃地撇嘴：“想吃自己烤肉去喵！这些是妮蔻大人的喵！”
说着，她抱着烤肉桶扭头跑回小队这里，将烤肉分给了众人。
精灵与人类相视一眼，争着去处理食材，抢着做各种食物。
“大家不要浪费粮食呀！”桑索菲亚提醒了一句，然后叉腰，看一群成年人就像看一群大孩子。
确定都是良性竞争，唐小队便不再去管。
唐继续展现着他出色的美食家天赋，餐刀切开面包，将一些生蔬片放在其中。
“我们再把烤肉放进去，然后是蜂蜜，再加一层蔬菜，最后盖上面包。”唐将做好的食物递给了姆莉。
姆莉接过马上咬了一大口，酸甜的口味加上饱满的内馅，跟以前吃的那些都不一样。果然唐的口味是超越时代的~
“来尝尝，大家也都试试，我推荐将多种不同特性的食材与酱料组合在一起。”唐又做了几个分给夏提拉和提姆，还有灰龙和帕蒂的。
妮蔻喜欢将烤肉换成小鱼，多格加了双层烤肉，辛西娅口味均衡，伊芙娜害怕吃胖加料极挑剔……
小妖精们听着众人的嬉闹与争执，默默驾驶机甲到相对安静的地方，然后出舱用魔法将树叶变成帕子，对着护林机甲上下擦拭。
“他们热闹他们的，这里才是我们的小天地，嘿咻~”大熊围着护林机甲仔细擦拭，尽量维护得像是新机。
其他小妖精也像大熊一样地爱护自己的机甲，保养结束累得全身酸痛，就进入驾驶舱休息。
小妖精们仰望着夜空，紫蓝色的天幕下还有许多繁星。
夜空不会给予他们温暖，但旁边距离他们不远的篝火会将光芒笼罩在他们的机甲上，机甲又会包容他们。
content_en:
In view of Tang's prestige between the two groups, people on both sides turned their attention to Tang and listened carefully to Tang's next words.
"Whether it's an elf or a human, you both recognize each other's role." Tang paid attention to the expressions of both groups.
There was no objection, just as Tang said.
"But at the same time, you also complained about each other's delaying behavior. I know that you did not blame others for your own disadvantages..."
Tang's speech was neither long nor short, just enough time for the two groups to think quietly, and people from both sides took turns speaking during the period.
The wind blew through the forest tops, bringing with it the sound of rustling trees.
"Since you all feel that your performance is superior and you want to frustrate the other party, then decide on a method that everyone can agree on and decide the outcome in an upright manner like a knight."
The elves and the church had this intention, and a knight immediately stood up.
"In that case, let's see who is more effective on the battlefield! If we lose, apologize to us for your arrogance."
Not to be outdone, the elves took two steps forward: "If you lose, admit that you were unreasonable barbarians who took the initiative to cause trouble, and apologize to us."
The fighting spirit on both sides is high, and no one wants to surrender to the other.
"Oh~ If there is a disagreement in the team, it will be troublesome." The white-haired dumpling who woke up just flew by.
Mu Li caught her father and looked at the group of people in front: "How about leaving two observers on each battlefield to determine the role of all parties and at the same time be alert for sneak attacks in the dark?"
Both parties nodded in agreement and swore by fist bumping.
After all, it was healthy competition, the minor conflicts were settled, and everyone could still live in peace, but the desire to win and lose among each other became unprecedentedly high.
"There's a lot of barbecue, does anyone want barbecue?" Nicole appeared holding a large bucket of barbecue, looking like a pregnant woman with a big belly, walking step by step.
"Here we are!"
"We want it too!"
"We humans can eat meat better! Elves should eat more vegetarian food!"
"Do you know what a combination of meat and vegetables is? Do you know how much protein you need every day? Do you know what dietary fiber is? Barbarians."
Nicole looked at the large group of guys begging for food in front of her, put down the barbecue bucket, and curled her lips in disgust: "If you want to eat your own barbecue, go and eat it! These are Lady Nicole's cats!"
With that said, she turned around and ran back to the team with the barbecue bucket in her arms, and distributed the barbecue to everyone.
The elves and humans looked at each other and scrambled to process the ingredients and make various foods.
"Don't waste food!" Sansofia warned, then put her hands on her hips and looked at a group of adults like a group of big children.
After determining that it was all healthy competition, Team Tang stopped taking care of it.
Don continued to display his excellent gourmet talents, cutting open the bread with a table knife and placing some raw vegetable slices inside.
"We'll put the roast meat in, then the honey, then add a layer of vegetables, and finally cover it with bread." Tang handed the prepared food to Mli.
Mli took it and took a big bite immediately. The sweet and sour taste and the full filling were different from those she had eaten before. Sure enough, Tang’s taste is beyond the times~
"Come and try it, everyone should try it too. I recommend combining a variety of ingredients and sauces with different characteristics." Tang made a few more to share with Shatila and Tim, as well as Gray Dragon and Patty.
Nicole likes to replace the grilled meat with small fish, Dogg adds double-layered grilled meat, Cynthia has a balanced taste, and Yvonne is afraid of eating fat and is very picky about toppings...
The goblins listened to everyone's play and arguments, and silently drove the mecha to a relatively quiet place. Then they went out of the cabin and used magic to turn leaves into handkerchiefs, and wiped them up and down on the forest ranger mecha.
"They are making fun of themselves. This is our little world, hehe~" Big Bear carefully wiped the forest ranger mecha and tried to maintain it as if it was new.
The other little goblins also took good care of their mechas like big bears. After the maintenance, their whole bodies ached from exhaustion, so they went into the cockpit to rest.
The goblins looked up at the night sky, and there were many stars under the purple-blue sky.
The night sky will not give them warmth, but the bonfire not far from them will cast light on their mechas, and the mechas will tolerate them.
